cells.Read by: Nothing in Tron. `flake.nix` exports it in the Nix dev shell.
cells.Values and default: Path of the `clang++-19` wrapper program in the Nix store. Unset: nothing changes. No file in the repository reads the environment variable.
cells.Effect: Nothing changes in Tron. No file in the repository reads the environment variable. `CMakePresets.json` sets the CMake cache variable of the same name to `clang++-19`, and that is a separate setting. The Nix dev shell also sets `CXX` to the same path.

cells.Read by: Nothing in Tron. `flake.nix` exports it in the Nix dev shell and in the Nix CMake builds (`tron-cmake-test-build`, `cmake-sandbox`).
cells.Set by: `flake.nix`, for the Nix dev shell and the Nix CMake builds.
cells.Values and default: Directory path in the Nix store: `${llvm19.compiler-rt}/lib`. On macOS the Nix dev shell sets empty text. Unset: nothing changes. No file in the repository reads this name.
cells.Effect: Nothing changes in Tron. No file in the repository reads this name. A comment in `flake.nix` says that the value is for `CMakeLists.txt`. `CMakeLists.txt` reads `COMPILER_RT_BUILTINS_ROOT` and not this name.

cells.Set by: `flake.nix`, in the Nix dev shells and the Nix checks.
cells.Values and default: Path of a Rust toolchain directory. `rust/run-cargo` requires the executable files `bin/cargo`, `bin/rustc`, `bin/rustdoc` and `bin/rustfmt` in it. Unset: no effect when `IN_NIX_SHELL` is empty. When `IN_NIX_SHELL` is not empty, `rust/run-cargo` and `rust/rust-toolchain.sh` stop with an error.
cells.Effect: `rust/run-cargo` and `rust/rust-toolchain.sh` read it only when `IN_NIX_SHELL` is not empty. `rust/run-cargo` runs `<value>/bin/cargo` and sets `RUSTC`, `RUSTDOC` and `RUSTFMT` to the tools in `<value>/bin`. `rust/rust-toolchain.sh` checks that `rustc` and `cargo` on `PATH` are the same files as in `<value>/bin`. `rust/rust-toolchain.sh` also requires that this `rustc` has the version in `rust-toolchain.toml`. `flake.nix` sets the variable in the Nix dev shells, in the lint shell, in its `lefthook` wrapper and in its checks.

cells.Set by: A developer with a prebuilt bundle. The Nix test build exports it.
cells.Values and default: Path of a plugin bundle directory. It holds `manifest.json` and generated plugin headers. The README examples use an absolute path. `make` does not expand the text. `make TRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE=path` also works. Unset: no bundle. `make` passes an empty value to CMake, and the build generates the plugin headers with ingest.
cells.Effect: `make` passes the path to CMake as `-DTRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE` in the configure targets `gen/config/core`, `gen/config/dev`, `gen/config/test` and `gen/config/prod`. CMake verifies the bundle, and the build copies the plugin headers from it in place of an ingest run. A changed value makes `make` run the CMake configure again. `make deb` passes an empty value. `make deb-host` passes none. CMake does not read the environment variable. A direct `cmake` run needs `-DTRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE=path`. With `REMOTE` set to `1`, `sku0` or `sku1`, the remote build job receives a command-line value but not an environment value.

cells.Values and default: Path of the stamp file (a file whose change makes `make` repeat a step). `make TRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE_STAMP=path` also works. Unset: `gen/.ingest_plugin_bundle_stamp`. Empty: the stamp helper fails, and `make` stops with `Failed to update` for goals that update the stamp.
cells.Effect: The stamp helper (`bin/ci/update-ingest-plugin-bundle-stamp.sh`) writes the value of `TRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE` and a newline into this file when the content differs. The targets `gen/config/core`, `gen/config/dev`, `gen/config/test` and `gen/config/prod` depend on the file. A changed file makes `make` run the CMake configure again. The helper creates the parent directory. The helper exits with an error when the path is a symbolic link, or exists and is not a regular file. `make` then stops with `Failed to update <path>`.

cells.Read by: Nothing in Tron. `GNUmakefile` assigns it and exports it to its recipes and to nested `make` runs.
cells.Values and default: Path of the program that updates the file that `TRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE_STAMP` names. `make` does not use a value from the environment. `make TRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE_STAMP_HELPER=path` replaces the program. Unset: `GNUmakefile` sets `bin/ci/update-ingest-plugin-bundle-stamp.sh`.
cells.Effect: A value in the environment has no effect. `GNUmakefile` assigns the fixed path with `:=`. `make` runs that program while it reads the makefile, and the targets `gen/config/core`, `gen/config/dev`, `gen/config/test` and `gen/config/prod` depend on the file. With `make -e` the environment value replaces the assignment of the makefile. No script in the checkout reads the exported variable.

cells.Values and default: Only the text `1` turns the stamp update on. Any other text counts as off. Unset: `make` sets `1` when no goal is given, or when a goal is outside its list of goals that do not use the bundle.
cells.Effect: With `1`, `make` runs the stamp helper (`bin/ci/update-ingest-plugin-bundle-stamp.sh`) while it reads the makefile. A value of `1` in the environment turns the stamp update on for the goals that skip it, for example `clean`, `lint` and `deb`. It is an internal variable of `GNUmakefile`. When `make` assigns `1`, it ignores an environment value. A command-line assignment replaces the value for every goal. `make` does not read it when the only goals are `list-tests` or `list-tests-core`.

cells.Set by: CI workflow `publish-deb.yml`, with `1` on feature branches.
cells.Values and default: Any text that is not empty turns it on. The text is not parsed. `0` and `false` also turn it on. Unset: off. On a branch other than `main` and `release-*` the version is `<YYYY.MM.DD>-<8-character commit hash>-<branch>`, or the tag of `HEAD` when one exists.
cells.Effect: On a named branch other than `main` and `release-*`, `bin/get-version.sh` prints `<tag without v>+feature.<branch>.<commits since the tag>.g<8-character commit hash>`. The tag is the nearest reachable tag that matches `v[0-9]*`. The script exits with code 1 when no such tag exists or the tag does not have the version form. A version tag is `v<numbers with dots>` with an optional `-devN`, `-tcN` or `-rcN`. It has no effect on `main`, `release-*` branches and a detached `HEAD`. `bin/make-version.sh` compiles the printed version into the programs. `bin/get-deb-version.sh` writes `+feature.` as `~feature.` in the Debian package version.

cells.Set by: A developer who builds `tron-host` for another apt channel.
cells.Values and default: A Debian package version, for example `2.0.0~1tc6` or `2026.07.01-2ebdc1e8`. The text is not checked. `make TRON_HOST_MIN_TRON=version` also works. Unset: `2.0.0~1tc6`. Empty: `packaging/tron-host/build-deb.sh` receives 2 arguments in place of 3 and exits with code 2.
cells.Effect: `make deb-host` passes the value to `packaging/tron-host/build-deb.sh`. The script writes `Depends: tron (>= <value>)` into the control file of the `tron-host` package. The value is the oldest `tron` package version that `tron-host` accepts. Only the target `deb-host` uses it. `tron-host` is the optional package that holds `rinzler_host` (a rinzler build that serves models on the CPU and needs no FPGA card).

cells.Read by: Job `refresh` of the Slice cost-data refresh. The workflow reads the value with the expression `vars[matrix.expected_bitfile_var]` and exports it as `EXPECTED_BITFILE`. The name itself is only in the matrix script (`bin/ci/bench_refresh_matrix.py`)
cells.Set by: GitHub repository settings. No file in the repository sets it.
cells.Values and default: Bitfile identity (the text `release-code@YYYY-MM-DD` that `bin/ci/bench_refresh_bitfile.py` builds from the report of each FPGA card). The script compares the lower-case value with it. No script checks the format. Unset: no identity is required. `bin/ci/bench_refresh_bitfile.py` still requires one identity on all FPGA cards and the complete device list.
cells.Effect: The refresh job for runner class `2x72core` gets the value as `EXPECTED_BITFILE`. When the FPGA cards report another bitfile identity, the job stops with `bitfile mismatch` before the measurement starts. The name is not in the workflow file. The matrix field `expected_bitfile_var` from `bin/ci/bench_refresh_matrix.py` selects it. A value in another format never matches. No process has this name in its environment.

cells.Read by: Job `refresh` of the Slice cost-data refresh. The workflow reads the value with the expression `vars[matrix.expected_bitfile_var]` and exports it as `EXPECTED_BITFILE`. The name itself is only in the matrix script (`bin/ci/bench_refresh_matrix.py`)
cells.Set by: GitHub repository settings. No file in the repository sets it.

The script compares the lower-case value with it. No script checks the format. Unset: no identity is required. `bin/ci/bench_refresh_bitfile.py` still requires one identity on all FPGA cards and the complete device list.

cells.Read by: Job `plan` of the Slice cost-data refresh and job `health` of its health check (`.github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml`, `.github/workflows/bench-refresh-health.yml`)
cells.Set by: GitHub repository settings. No file in the repository sets it.
cells.Values and default: Set the exact lower-case text `true` to enable. `bin/ci/bench-refresh-ci.sh` tests the exact text. The health check tests it with the workflow expression `== 'true'`. Unset: only runner class `2x96core` is refreshed. The health check expects only `2x96core`.
cells.Effect: `true` adds runner class `2x72core` to the Slice cost-data refresh. The health check (the workflow that looks for recent refresh runs) then also expects `2x72core`. Job `plan` copies it to `ENABLE_2X72`. Without `true`, the value `all` of the workflow input `runner_class` selects only `2x96core`. The value `2x72core` then stops job `plan` with `2x72core refreshes are disabled`.
